name: Solomon
source:
The Wizard of the South

Love Tendency: Mysterious and unpredictable, but shows a true, deep love.
Place: The country of the Quadlings
Motto: Give, for that will lead you to true happiness

Solomon is the Wizard of the South who loves the Land of Oz and gives his everything for the goodness of the land. He was also a good comrade of yours during your journey long ago.
This time, he is the very person who invites you to the Land of Oz once again to fulfill a certain prophecy. He usually kindly watches over you from afar along with Norton, but from time to time, he approaches you mysteriously.
Wesley thinks that he is hiding something and shouldn't be trusted. Could it be...?

[Official in-game description]
